name: Spotify AppImage
tagline: Unofficial standalone AppImage repackaging of the official Spotify Linux build
description: An unofficial, community-maintained AppImage for Spotify, packaged directly from the official Spotify snap/deb releases with wide Linux distribution compatibility and no sandboxing bottlenecks.
features: Streams millions of songs, albums, and original podcasts
System tray integration and MPRIS media player controls
No Snap or Flatpak runtime overhead required
requirements: Linux x86_64, Spotify Free or Premium account
